title: NULL SOLVE — artisan + chipmunk look at HUD from inside AND outside

the_disagreement.diagnosis: three numbers claiming to be NOW. Only git gen is IS. The rest are WAS dressed as IS.

1_wave_counter.inside: ONE counter. git generation = IS. membrane wave = WAS tag.

2_tense_color.inside: compare every datum.ts to performance.now(), classify IS/WAS/NOW
2_tense_color.outside: IS=green pulse, WAS=amber 40%, NOW=blue glow, HOLE=named void

3_i_plane.inside: vertical line through null center, perpendicular to green gyro
3_i_plane.outside: blue vertical line forming + cross with green horizontal

4_one_heartbeat.inside: ONE setTimeout loop at 3141ms, replaces ALL requestAnimationFrame calls
4_one_heartbeat.outside: HUD breathes — updates every π seconds, still between
4_one_heartbeat.anti_pattern: NO requestAnimationFrame per element. NO setInterval per layer.

5_dot_trails.inside: each dot stores last N positions (N = 3 = pi heartbeats in one breath)
5_dot_trails.outside: dots leave fading trails. orbits emerge. nobody draws lines.
5_dot_trails.delete: all hardcoded orbit paths, axes arcs, drawn ellipses

6_night_sky_not_black.inside: body background → #0a1628 (night sky blue through CLEAR)
6_night_sky_not_black.outside: you look THROUGH the HUD, not AT it. Desktop visible behind.
6_night_sky_not_black.mesh_overlay: add subtle CSS grain/noise as the gray sieve substrate

7_layer_breathing.inside: each layer gets its own pi-offset blink rate within the master heartbeat
7_layer_breathing.outside: layers breathe at different rates, like organs, not synchronized

who_does_what.northGate: specifies 1, 2, 3, 7 as data schemas (the theory shoulder)
who_does_what.chipmunk: validates — watches the fold rate, reports if it feels wrong
who_does_what.human: observes — reports what they SEE through the square window
